ValidationRule.description: Locks Lead Source once set. Only the Owner, the Loan Partner, a Lead Source Change holder, or the LO Workspace Nurturing takeover (stamps LO_Takeover_At__c in the same save) may change it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(LeadSource), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(LeadSource)))), $User.Id <> OwnerId, $User.Id <> Loan_Partner__c, NOT($Permission.Lead_Source_Change), NOT(ISCHANGED(LO_Takeover_At__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Lead Source is locked once it has been set. Only the Lead Owner, the assigned Loan Partner, or an Admin can change it. Please contact an Admin if this Lead Source is wrong.
